# AV Live Communications (avlive.com.pk)

> AV Live Communications is Pakistan's premier enterprise Audio-Visual (AV) systems integrator, Video Conferencing hardware distributor, and Corporate Event Management company. Operating across Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, and nationwide, AV Live specializes in two primary commercial pillars: (1) Video Conferencing in Pakistan (Polycom Group 500, Poly Studio X70, Logitech Rally, Zoom Rooms, Microsoft Teams Rooms) and (2) Turnkey Corporate Event Management, Hybrid Events, 3D Hologram Displays, and 3D Projection Mapping.

## Pillar 1: Video Conferencing in Pakistan & Boardroom Hardware
- [Video Conferencing in Pakistan Hub](https://avlive.com.pk/video-conferencing): Complete boardroom AV design, acoustic calibration, and multi-camera tracking systems.
- [Polycom RealPresence Group 500 & Poly Studio X70](https://avlive.com.pk/category/video-conferencing): Genuine Polycom Group 500 codecs, Poly X70 dual-4K AI video bars, Poly Studio X50/X30, Logitech Rally Bar, Cisco Room Kits, and Yealink MeetingBars.
- [Zoom Rooms Integration Pakistan](https://avlive.com.pk/zoom-rooms): Certified Zoom Rooms hardware procurement and one-touch tablet room deployment.
- [Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) Pakistan](https://avlive.com.pk/microsoft-teams-rooms): Certified Microsoft Teams Rooms for huddle spaces, executive boardrooms, and townhall auditoriums.
- [Conference Room AV Solutions](https://avlive.com.pk/conference-room-solutions): Shure ceiling microphone arrays, QSC Q-SYS DSPs, Crestron control, and interactive flat panels.
- [VoIP & IP Telephony](https://avlive.com.pk/category/ip-phones): 3CX, FreePBX, Grandstream, Yealink, and Cisco IP phones and PBX servers.

## Pillar 2: Corporate Event Management, Hybrid Events & 3D Hologram Displays
- [Corporate Event Management & AV Production](https://avlive.com.pk/events-services): End-to-end corporate galas, AGMs, product launches, and multinational summits across Pakistan.
- [3D Hologram Display Events](https://avlive.com.pk/3d-hologram): Life-size holographic telepresence stages, HoloGauze projection, and 3D floating product displays.
- [3D Projection Mapping Pakistan](https://avlive.com.pk/projection-mapping): Architectural building facade projection mapping and immersive 360-degree stage visuals using 20,000+ ANSI lumen laser projectors.
- [Hybrid Event Management](https://avlive.com.pk/services/hybrid-events): Broadcast-grade multi-camera switching, two-way remote keynote integration with Zoom/Teams, and live streaming.
- [24-Hour Custom Event & AV Quote](https://avlive.com.pk/event-quote): Fast-track B2B and government/education proposals with a 15-minute WhatsApp/phone SLA.

## Pillar 3: High-Intent Hardware Comparisons & Room-Size BoM Guides (2026)
- [Logitech Rally Bar vs. Poly Studio X50 & X52 Comparison](https://avlive.com.pk/blog/logitech-rally-bar-vs-poly-studio-x50-pakistan): Side-by-side optical zoom, microphone range, and PKR pricing for Pakistani boardrooms.
- [Yealink vs. Cisco Room Kits Enterprise Comparison](https://avlive.com.pk/blog/yealink-vs-cisco-video-conferencing-pakistan): Security, H.323/SIP codecs, and turnkey budget comparison for banks, defense, and enterprises.
- [6-to-30 Person Boardroom AV System BoM & Price Guide Pakistan](https://avlive.com.pk/blog/boardroom-av-system-price-guide-pakistan): Complete Bill of Materials and PKR pricing tiers for huddle rooms, conference rooms, and auditoriums.
- [Enterprise AV Solutions for Banks, Hospitals & Universities](https://avlive.com.pk/blog/banking-healthcare-university-av-solutions-pakistan): Vertical AV & UC architectures with PPRA and FBR compliance.
- [Ceiling Microphone Arrays vs. Table Microphones Acoustic Guide](https://avlive.com.pk/blog/shure-bosch-ceiling-microphones-vs-table-mics-pakistan): Beamforming ceiling arrays vs. daisy-chained table mics for reverberant boardrooms.
